text: Good evening. I am the grandmother, looking after my granddaughter who is 9 months. Her temperature is 37.9, I checked under the arm two times. She is having some insect bites, three or four on her legs, mosquito I am thinking, and she is itching and rubbing them only. Her mother is on night shift so I am managing. I have not slept properly from two days myself, very tired. Kindly tell me if something to put on the bites and whether 37.9 is needing medicine or we can wait till morning.
